# St. Xavier's High School, Siwan

Official website: https://www.stxavierssiwan.com/

St. Xavier's High School is a CBSE-affiliated school located at Baishakhi, Siwan, Bihar, offering education from Nursery to Class 12 with a focus on academic excellence, values, and all-round student development.
